name: pawconnect
description: Local development commands for the PawConnect application.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:up && npm run db:setup --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
